titleEn: I Forgot to Close the Door

pages.text: A blizzard blew outside. Grandma lit the fire to warm the room. The floor was toasty.
"Today, I'll roll around inside with Momo." Yuki carried Momo into the room.
Yuki went outside and brought in a handful of snow. The door stood wide open.
Yuki went out and in again. Cold wind rushed through the opening. "Oh, I forgot again."
Momo moved farther from the door and lay down. Yuki rolled a snowball beside it. "Why go over there?"
The room cooled little by little. Yuki's nose felt cold.
Momo curled tightly in a corner. Yuki rubbed their hands. "It's not warm at all."
Grandma guided Yuki's hand to the door's gap. "The warmth escapes through the door."
Yuki closed the door tightly each time they went out. Click. Click. "Now it can't escape."
The room grew toasty again. Momo slept relaxed, belly up. Yuki lay beside them, swinging their feet.
